prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a cat version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: Draw a square reaction meme of a butter-yellow cat caught mid-cackle. Give it the silhouette of a squat cartoon dinosaur, with a little round head flowing straight into a pear-shaped belly and two tiny forepaws. Keep it unmistakably feline with pointed ears, a pink button nose, and whiskers that fan out from its plump cheeks. Show it in three-quarter view, leaning back with its chin tipped up. Its cheeks bunch so high that its eyes squeeze into two curved slits. Stretch its grin from cheek to cheek and drop the jaw into a huge open laugh, with a dark mouth and a rounded pink tongue visible inside. Its little paws curl against its belly as if it can barely catch its breath. Use soft, rounded 3D cartoon rendering, warm light, and a plain, softly blurred background. Crop close enough that the laugh reads instantly at sticker size. No text.
